verdict.rationale: Missive documents a command bar opened with ⌘/Ctrl + K that runs actions such as snooze and search, and its docs refer to keyboard shortcuts and quick commands. A community user calls it a "proper snappy desktop app," though another notes the Snooze shortcut opens different selectors in different contexts. missing for 10: a documented comprehensive shortcut reference or evidence that every action is keyboard-reachable, and first-party or measured performance evidence beyond a single anecdote.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait

citations.quote: or by opening the command bar with ⌘/Ctrl + K and typing "snooze".
Master the command bar: keyboard shortcuts and quick commands.
Missive feels like a proper snappy desktop app
